_comment: Hand-maintained hints for tools/update.mjs. 'informalization' lists repos whose site reads a Lean proof back into plain English; they get the featured section. 'exclude' hides repos from the page. 'description' overrides the text shown for a repo. 'sites' adds extra site links per repo (label + url); the repo's own Pages/homepage is always probed and listed first. 'language' overrides the language pill when GitHub's primary language is wrong (e.g. a Lean repo whose explainer JS outweighs the Lean).

description.openai: Unofficial, AI-assisted plain-English explainer of a Lean 4 proof by others: full support of the zero-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick order parameter, from OpenAI's openai/math (Apache-2.0). Not affiliated with OpenAI; drafts are unreviewed and may contain mistakes — the Lean source is the ground truth.
description.vau-calculus: In-progress Lean 4 formalization of John N. Shutt's vau calculus, with a plain-English informalization of the current work. An actor layer is planned and is not completed. Unofficial, unreviewed drafts (AI-drafted); not official documentation.
